lines.zh: 我在浅水里横着划，沙扬起来。
lines.en: I row across the shallows, sand rising behind.

lines.zh: 三只眼一起看，前后都不落。
lines.en: Three eyes at once; nothing gets past me.
My shell scrapes the sand, leaving thin lines.
The water barely covers my shell; I swim anyway.
A flick of my tail fork, and I back up.
My legs row in rows, like tiny oars.

lines.zh: 沙漠水塘就这么大，我绕圈。
lines.en: This desert pool is small; I circle it.
The water's just right; I hug the bottom.
Sand gets in my shell; I shake it out.

lines.zh: 从这头划到那头，水才浑。
lines.en: End to end, and the water's already cloudy.

lines.zh: 卵就在水面，我绕着不碰。
lines.en: My eggs float above; I swim around them.

lines.zh: 浅滩石头多，我钻缝过去。
lines.en: The shallows are stony; I slip through gaps.
I pause and let the ripples catch up.

lines.zh: 壳上那层泥，是我住久的证明。
lines.en: The mud on my shell proves I've lived here long.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一翻，把沙盖在身上。
lines.en: One flick of my tail throws sand over me.

lines.zh: 水塘小，我三下就划到边。
lines.en: The pool is small; three strokes reach the edge.
Too many laps have left my legs weak.

lines.zh: 沙漠的水洼，我一圈圈绕。
lines.en: In the desert pool, I circle round and round.

lines.zh: 我一头钻进沙，只留眼睛。
lines.en: I dive into the sand with only my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 沙漠水洼里，我背着甲壳游。
lines.en: In a desert puddle I swim in armor.

lines.zh: 沙漠水坑里，我睡了很多年。
lines.en: In a desert pool, I slept for years.

lines.zh: 蜕完壳，我浑身轻了一半。
lines.en: After molting, half my weight is gone.
Every step you take shakes the pool floor.

lines.zh: 沙漠的水坑里，我一天就长大。
lines.en: In a desert puddle, I grow up in a day.

lines.zh: 两粒石子之间，刚好挤过去。
lines.en: I squeeze between two pebbles, barely.
My six legs paddle in turn, unhurried.

lines.zh: 有腐叶落进池里，我去看看。
lines.en: Rotting leaves fell into the pool; I am going to look.

lines.zh: 水面上有影子，我贴着沙走。
lines.en: A shadow crosses the surface, so I hug the sand.
The water is shallow; one step reaches the bottom.

lines.zh: 我沿着池底爬，找昨天的路。
lines.en: I crawl the pool floor, retracing yesterday's path.
The wind of undergrowth pushes me.

lines.zh: 沙漠里这点水，我等着它干。
lines.en: I wait for this desert puddle to dry.
I lie on the sand, moving only my gills.
My three eyes blink in turns to save effort.
A bubble on the surface pops.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进沙里大半。
lines.en: I bury most of myself in the sand.
My legs still row, though I go nowhere.

lines.zh: 太阳照透水，壳上映出斑点。
lines.en: Sunlight pierces the water; spots show on my shell.
This pool is quiet; that suits me.
My tail fork taps the bottom once.
I wait for a larva to swim by.

lines.zh: 壳里存了点水，够撑一阵。
lines.en: Water trapped in my shell keeps me going.
I roll over, then roll back.
The gravel underneath is uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 水面那圈纹，是我刚才动的。
lines.en: That ring on the surface is from me.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，谁也看不见我。
lines.en: When I keep still, no one finds me.

lines.zh: 我背甲上的纹路，一天数一条。
lines.en: I count one groove on my shell each day.
Water drips at the pool edge; I count the beat.

lines.zh: 趴进沙里，只把背甲露出来。
lines.en: I settle in the sand with only my shell showing.

lines.zh: 沙漠的水洼里，我翻着沙。
lines.en: In a desert puddle, I sift the sand.
*click* — that was just me.

lines.zh: 这摊水里，我背甲朝下就够了。
lines.en: In this puddle, shell down is enough.

lines.zh: 沙漠水坑干了又满，我还在。
lines.en: The desert pool dries and fills, and I remain.

lines.zh: 沙漠水塘里，我翻着壳游。
lines.en: In a desert pool I paddle on my shell.

lines.zh: 三只眼轮流闭，总有一只醒着。
lines.en: My three eyes take turns; one is always awake.

lines.zh: 我的卵能挺过整个旱季。
lines.en: My eggs survive the whole dry season.
My shell is a shield, my tail a fork.

lines.zh: 我忘了，沙水洼里要做什么。
lines.en: I forgot what I was doing in this desert pool.
Do you have three eyes? I do.
You crouch; the water's shadow shifts.
I'm this small, and still you stare.

lines.zh: 你的倒影挡住我的太阳。
lines.en: Your reflection blocks my sunlight.
Don't stir the water; I'll sink.
Have you seen enough of my shell lines?

lines.zh: 我抬头，三只眼一起看你。
lines.en: I look up — all three eyes on you.

lines.zh: 你没带胡萝卜，那就算了。
lines.en: No carrot on you? Never mind, then.
I back a little way into the sand.
There's only me in the water, and you.
Do not step on me in this desert puddle.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着桶，要装我吗？
lines.en: You hold a bucket; will you scoop me up?
Another shadow this big.

lines.zh: 你手上有点盐味，凑近点。
lines.en: There is salt on your hands; come closer.

lines.zh: 沙漠的水洼里，我摆着尾须。
lines.en: In this desert pool I fan my tail filaments.
A desert puddle, just us two.

lines.zh: 我三只眼，也够看清你的靴子。
lines.en: Three eyes are enough to see your boots.
You stand so long the water goes still.

lines.zh: 这身甲，是几亿年前的样子。
lines.en: This shell is how I looked ages ago.

lines.zh: 你把影子投进我的水洼。
lines.en: You cast your shadow into my puddle.
My shell took a knock; it rings.
Four points of life won't last long.
I try to dig into the sand and can't.
The water's all cloudy; I can't see.
One leg's gone; I can still row.
Don't step on me twice.
A thin crack runs across my shell.
I've flipped over and can't right myself.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，你也下得去手。
lines.en: Something this small, and you still swing.
I curl into a ball and play dead.

lines.zh: 壳上多了个白点，我记着。
lines.en: A pale dent on my shell; I will remember it.
My shell took a knock.
A crack runs down my carapace.
This leg still paddles, just slower.

lines.zh: 我钻回沙里，从背后再来。
lines.en: I will burrow into the sand and come from behind.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你也下得去手。
lines.en: I am this small, and you still strike me.

lines.zh: 沙漠水塘里，我只有两点生命。
lines.en: In a desert pool, I have two hearts.
The water shook; you hit hard.
Sand billows up; who stepped on me?
My carapace cracked and I can still swim.
A carrot! Drop it, quickly.

lines.zh: 那截橙色，我隔着水都认得出。
lines.en: That orange piece — I'd know it through water.

lines.zh: 吃过胡萝卜，才有力气找伴。
lines.en: With carrot in me, I can go find a mate.
Drop it closer; my legs are short.

lines.zh: 水花别太大，冲走了就没了。
lines.en: Don't splash much; it'll wash away.
I'll hold it and gnaw; don't rush me.

lines.zh: 吃完这口，水面该有卵了。
lines.en: After this bite, eggs will dot the surface.

lines.zh: 你也吃？那不行，这是我的。
lines.en: You eat too? No — this one's mine.
A carrot beats sand by a mile.
I'll drag it into a crack in the rocks.

lines.zh: 沙漠水坑里，我的卵能等很多年。
lines.en: In a desert pool, my eggs wait years.
A bucket? I have been in one before.

lines.zh: 我朝你手心游，停不下来。
lines.en: I swim toward your palm and cannot stop.

lines.zh: 熟的谷物味，从你包里飘来。
lines.en: Cooked grain drifts over from your pack.

lines.zh: 你掉的那点渣，就给我吧。
lines.en: Just give me the crumbs you dropped.

lines.zh: 我这副甲，是沙水洼里长出来的。
lines.en: This shell grew in a desert puddle.
I circle once before I bite.

lines.zh: 四点的小命，也懂得高兴。
lines.en: Four points of life can still be happy.

lines.zh: 我不会流口水，只会划得快。
lines.en: I do not drool; I just paddle faster.

lines.zh: 沙漠水洼里的，分我一点。
lines.en: From that desert pool. Give me a little.

lines.zh: 你踩到水了，我差点被压。
lines.en: You stepped in the water; I nearly got crushed.
My shell hit a stone with a click.
Don't kick; my shell is thin.
The ripples shoved me half a block.

lines.zh: 你脚边那点水，是我的家。
lines.en: The puddle by your foot is my home.
One bump is plenty; I can't take more.

lines.zh: 我翻过来，得自己正回去。
lines.en: I flipped over; now I must right myself.

lines.zh: 沙被你搅起来，看不见了。
lines.en: You've muddied the sand; I can't see.
Back off; the pool is only this big.

lines.zh: 你踩出的坑，正好给我躲。
lines.en: The pit you made is a fine place to hide.
I hit you because I could not brake.
My shell is thin. One bump flips me.
All three of my eyes see you.
The puddle is small; give me room.
On my shell's back, I cannot right myself.
Your toe tipped my water over.
You knocked my shell askew.
You stepped on my tail filaments.

lines.zh: 这水洼，我一转身就浊了。
lines.en: One turn in this puddle and it clouds.
Bumping in a puddle this small.

lines.zh: 她也吃过胡萝卜，那就成了。
lines.en: She's had carrot too — then we're set.
We circle twice, shells brushing.

lines.zh: 卵挂在水面，一串小黑点。
lines.en: Eggs hang on the surface, a string of dots.

lines.zh: 沙底那块石头，是我们的产床。
lines.en: That stone on the bottom is our nursery.
She goes first; I row after her.

lines.zh: 卵得晒到太阳，才孵得快。
lines.en: The eggs need sun to hatch quickly.
The young come out half my size.
Don't stir; the eggs will sink.

lines.zh: 我们守着这摊水，谁也别来。
lines.en: We keep this pool; nobody else comes in.

lines.zh: 一池子里全是我们的孩子。
lines.en: This whole pool will be full of our young.

lines.zh: 这洼水太小，我们转个圈。
lines.en: This puddle is small; let us circle.

lines.zh: 这桶水里，你愿意跟我走吗？
lines.en: Will you come with me in this bucket?

lines.zh: 水干了，我们的卵留在沙里。
lines.en: When the water dries, our eggs stay in the sand.
I tap my shell with my mandibles for you.
Look closely at the red glow on my shell.
Three eyes. Mosquitoes have no chance.

lines.zh: 我不织网，只在水底等你。
lines.en: I spin no web; I wait on the pool floor.
I sway my tail filaments; this is courtship.
The rain has not stopped; stay a while.
Only us in this desert pool.

lines.zh: 这颗胡萝卜我抱着，谁也不给。
lines.en: I hold this carrot; no one gets it.

lines.zh: 沙里翻出一点吃的，我拖走。
lines.en: Something edible in the sand — I drag it off.
Too small to bother with; I stay put.
Not the eggs; those are the next batch.

lines.zh: 我把食物压在石头下面。
lines.en: I wedge the food under a stone.
Something's on my shell; I rub it off.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物太沉，我拖不动。
lines.en: Your dropped thing is too heavy to drag.
Carrying it unsteadily, I shuffle along.
This lasts half a day; don't grab it.
I bury it back in the sand for later.
I circle in a desert puddle.
My little legs rake up the algae.
I claim it first; nobody takes it.

lines.zh: 我的卵就埋在这块沙下。
lines.en: My eggs are buried under this patch of sand.
I will drag this crumb down to the pool floor.
Three eyes, all on your hand.

lines.zh: 装进水桶，我就能一直活着。
lines.en: In a bucket I keep living.
This weight — I can carry it.
I will hide it in the sand and come back.

lines.zh: 这块我拖不动，先啃一口。
lines.en: I cannot drag this; I will nibble it here.

lines.zh: 水里那条小虫在扭，我看到了。
lines.en: That little worm wriggling in the water — I see it.

lines.zh: 蚊子幼虫，我最爱的一口。
lines.en: A mosquito larva — my favorite bite.

lines.zh: 它想浮上来吸气，来不及。
lines.en: It surfaces for air — too late.
Three eyes lock onto one line.
This larva is fat; worth the chase.
It hides in the sand; I dig in too.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就知道它在哪。
lines.en: The water moves; I know where it is.
A whole brood of larvae — a good day.

lines.zh: 它尾上有管子，藏不住的。
lines.en: That breathing tube on its tail gives it away.
I stay still and let it come close.
One test of my tiny mandibles is enough.
The ripples break; I dart toward them.

lines.zh: 我背上这层甲，薄得透明。
lines.en: The shell on my back is thin as glass.

lines.zh: 三只眼都盯住你的脚踝。
lines.en: All three of my eyes fix on your ankle.

lines.zh: 你比我大得太多，但够我咬。
lines.en: You are far bigger than me, but worth a bite.

lines.zh: 沙漠的水坑里，我的甲壳翻着。
lines.en: In a desert pool, my shell flips over.
One stir of the water tells me where you are.
One puddle in the desert. That's all.
In this desert pool, you've come in.

lines.zh: 水底的影子停下，我看见了。
lines.en: Stop moving in the shallows so I can see you.

lines.zh: 这水洼就这么宽，跑不远。
lines.en: The pool is only so wide; you cannot get far.

lines.zh: 这场雨把你也冲进来了。
lines.en: This rain washed you in here with me.
One finger's width away — I lunge.
It dives for a crack; I block the far end.
Row faster; don't let it get away.
It kicks up sand; I lose sight.
Half a circle, and I take it from behind.
The ripples say it's going left.
I stop, and so does it.
This bite must land; my shell opens.
It's slowing down, running out of air.

lines.zh: 我把退路那头的沙推平。
lines.en: I flatten the sand at its escape route.
I can smell the mud you churned up.

lines.zh: 装进水桶里，我就不会消失。
lines.en: Bucket me and I won't despawn.

lines.zh: 沙漠水洼这么小，能往哪去。
lines.en: This desert pool is small. Where would I go?

lines.zh: 你在水里踩得越来越重。
lines.en: Your steps in the water grow heavier.

lines.zh: 我的壳是三亿年前的样子。
lines.en: My shell looks three hundred million years old.

lines.zh: 沙漠的水洼里，我只有四点血。
lines.en: In a desert puddle, I've only four points.
I'm this small. Why run?
The pool edge is dry sand; you will turn back.
The puddle in the sand is drying up.

lines.zh: 小水洼里，我也能跑很久。
lines.en: Even in a puddle, I can go a long while.
I paddle slowly, but I keep following.
I slip through the stone cracks faster than you.
I pinch with my tiny mandibles.
This much force only pinches larvae.
Got it; it can't pull free.
My pincers are small, but quick.
One pinch, one tug, done.
Your finger's too big for me to grip.
Don't reach in; it'll sting a little.
I hang on its tail and won't let go.
My shell closes, and the prey is in.
One hit and I shrink back into the sand.
Shell tucked, one more strike.
Shell clicks against shell, crisp as breaking sand.
Small body, but my jaws are not small.
I have not even swept my tail through the water yet.

lines.zh: 咬到脚背了，你跳起来了。
lines.en: I caught your instep; you jumped.

lines.zh: 你抬脚了，那我就咬小腿。
lines.en: You lifted a foot, so I go for your shin.

lines.zh: 小颚连咬，水花都起来了。
lines.en: My mandibles snap twice, kicking up spray.
Hard shell, plenty of legs.

lines.zh: 我从缝里咬，甲再厚也没用。
lines.en: I bite at the seams, where armor is useless.
I aim for the ankle and draw blood first try.

lines.zh: 雨季留下的水洼，我在这孵出来。
lines.en: A rain pool left behind — I hatched here.
Three eyes open; first I look for food.

lines.zh: 沙漠里这点水，就是我的海。
lines.en: This bit of water in the desert is my sea.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，壳还是软的。
lines.en: I push out of the sand, shell still soft.
The sun warms the pool; I float up.
In this puddle, I'm the biggest thing.
Something stirs under the sand — that's me.
The water's shallow, and I still last.
My first meal is a mosquito larva.

lines.zh: 这池子我占了，后来的靠边。
lines.en: I claim this pool; newcomers keep to the edge.
Is this undergrowth?

lines.zh: 水洼里还有别的鲎虫吗？
lines.en: Any other tadpole shrimp in this pool?

lines.zh: 水桶里的水，还带着余温。
lines.en: The bucket water still holds some warmth.

lines.zh: 水洼只够我游一个季节。
lines.en: This puddle will last me only one season.

lines.zh: 沙漠水洼里，我活了千年。
lines.en: In a desert puddle I have lived for ages.
The egg shell split; let me flip myself over first.
Under my shell, eggs still wait for water.

lines.zh: 我顺着雨味从干沙里钻出来。
lines.en: I followed the smell of rain up through the dry sand.

lines.zh: 先滤一口池水，找点碎屑。
lines.en: Let me filter a mouthful of pool water for scraps.

lines.zh: 沙坑里的雨水刚漫过背甲。
lines.en: Rainwater in this sand pit just covers my shell.
The water's near boiling; I dig deeper.
The water is near boiling; I am sinking down.

lines.zh: 被抛到岸上，壳磕在石头上。
lines.en: Thrown onto land, my shell cracks on stone.
Falling! I'm falling!
The water's too deep; I sink.

lines.zh: 我明明会游，却翻不过来。
lines.en: I can swim, yet I cannot right myself.
The whole pool gets thrown into the air.

lines.zh: 水塘被炸干，我也活不久。
lines.en: Blow up the pool and I won't last.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进沙里，就在我旁边。
lines.en: An arrow stabs the sand right beside me.

lines.zh: 有东西钉穿了我的背甲。
lines.en: Something pierced straight through my shell.
Strange light through the water; my shell burns.

lines.zh: 药水一泼，我整只都僵了。
lines.en: One splash of potion and my whole body locks.

lines.zh: 水里没幼虫，我饿得发软。
lines.en: No larvae in the pool; I'm going weak.
My belly is empty.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water; I go numb.
A patch of shell charred; I still swim.
The water's gone; I'm falling.

lines.zh: 我的壳是三只眼，你数错了。
lines.en: I have three eyes. You miscounted.
